TableData.name: unZeroGL
v_loan_cust
TableData.Query: select trade_id,csnm,ccy,matdate, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"notesell_bl","notesell_bl/'" + rpunit+"'") } notesell_bl, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"notesell_blcny","notesell_blcny/'" + rpunit+"'") } notesell_blcny, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"notesell_blusd","notesell_blusd/'" + rpunit+"'") } notesell_blusd, loangrade, loan_risk , loan_prd, dtyp, use_loan, ctnm,cs,islocal,ctnt,source,parentbrca ,importdate from v_loan_cust where importdate='${rpdate}' ${if(len(brca) == 0,"","and parentbrca = '" + brca + "'")} and notesell_bl<>0

TableData.name: v_deposit_cust
TableData.Query: SELECT dlno,csnm,ccy,dtyp, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"workingbalance","workingbalance/'" + rpunit+"'") } workingbalance, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"workingbalancecny","workingbalancecny/'" + rpunit+"'") } workingbalancecny, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"workingbalanceusd","workingbalanceusd/'" + rpunit+"'") } workingbalanceusd, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"pcpl","pcpl/'" + rpunit+"'") } pcpl, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"pcplcny","pcplcny/'" + rpunit+"'") } pcplcny, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"pcplusd","pcplusd/'" + rpunit+"'") } pcplusd, parentbrca , brca , ctnm, ctnt, cs, islocal, source, nesclv1, nesclv2 FROM v_deposit_cust WHERE importdate='${rpdate}' ${if(len(brca) == 0,"","and parentbrca = '" + brca + "'")} and workingbalance<>0

TableData.name: v_fixmm_cust
TableData.Query: SELECT dlno,csnm,ccy,category, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"pcpl","pcpl/'" + rpunit+"'") } pcpl, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"pcplcny","pcplcny/'" + rpunit+"'") } pcplcny, ${if(len(rpunit) == 0,"pcplusd","pcplusd/'" + rpunit+"'") } pcplusd, parentbrca , ctnm, ctnt, cs, islocal FROM v_fixmm_cust WHERE importdate='${rpdate}' ${if(len(brca) == 0,"","and parentbrca = '" + brca + "'")} and pcpl<>0
